title: Start by building your world, characters, creatures, and story before using…
content:
Start by building your world, characters, creatures, and story before using Agent One in Seedance 2.

Use Agent One to develop the story from your script, then generate shots, create animations, and edit sequences.

Create a visual style preview in Midjourney first, then use it to guide your Seedance 2 animation.
